PM Modi's 'Dimagi Naxal' Remark Sparks Political Debate

Prime Minister Narendra Modi warned against "dimagi naxals" (ideological naxals) in his Independence Day speech, stating they promote frustration and anti-development mindsets. Union Minister Kiren Rijiju defended the statement, linking it to the Congress party. Opposition figures P. Chidambaram and Arvind Kejriwal have embraced the term, with Chidambaram stating pride in being one and Kejriwal calling himself a "dimagi Naxal." Mehbooba Mufti also responded, linking her support for Article 370 to the label. BJP leaders have criticized the opposition's reaction, with one calling the Congress the "Dimagi Naxal Congress."
